| # Reliability parameters {#reliability-parameters-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                          |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   Fulfillment of electromagnetic interference immunity tested by route A (follow EMC requirements of the relevant product standards) regarding ISO 13849-1:2023
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

Reliability parameters according to ISO 13849 and ISO 25119 involve mean time to dangerous failure (MTTFD) and diagnostic coverage (DC).

MTTFD is defined as the average value of the expected time to a dangerous failure. The classification according to ISO 13849-1 and ISO 25119-2 is shown below.

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| MTTFD according to                                                        |
|                                                                           |
| EN ISO 13849-1, Table 4 and ISO 25119-2, Table 4                          |
+-------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
| Denotation                          | Range                               |
+=====================================+=====================================+
| Low                                 | 3 years ≤ MTTFD \< 10 years         |
+-------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
| Medium                              | 10 years ≤ MTTFD \< 30 years        |
+-------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+
| High                                | 30 years ≤ MTTFD \< 100 years\*     |
+-------------------------------------+-------------------------------------+

\* limitation of the MTTFD for each channel to 100 years is only required by EN ISO 13849.

 

DC covers all measures of the effectiveness of diagnostics, which may be determined as the ratio between the failure rate of detected dangerous failures and the failure rate of total dangerous failures. The classification according to ISO 13849-1 and ISO 25119-2 is shown below.

 

+---------------------------------------------+
| DC according to EN ISO 13849-1, Table 5     |
+----------------------+----------------------+
| Denotation           | Range                |
+======================+======================+
| None                 | DC \< 60%            |
+----------------------+----------------------+
| Low                  | 60% ≤ DC \< 90%      |
+----------------------+----------------------+
| Medium               | 90% ≤ DC \< 99%      |
+----------------------+----------------------+
| High                 | 99% ≤ DC             |
+----------------------+----------------------+

 

+-----------------------------------------+
| DC according to ISO 25119-2, Table 5    |
+--------------------+--------------------+
| Denotation         | Range              |
+====================+====================+
| Low                | DC \< 60%          |
+--------------------+--------------------+
| Medium             | 60% ≤ DC \< 90%    |
+--------------------+--------------------+
| High               | 90% ≤ DC           |
+--------------------+--------------------+

The values for the safety function 1 (system integrity) can be taken from the table as well.
